messages:
Rae (Design): Quick thread: thinking about an 'axis compactification' mode for small panels. Goal: keep visual scale stable (no autoscale on single blips), reduce axis clutter, and surface spike callouts. Prototype idea attached in Figma. Thoughts?

Ben (PM): Love the stability goal. Users get confused when a single blip shifts the whole y-axis. We should be explicit about what is being hidden vs annotated.

Kai (Data Viz): Proposal: never rescale based on single-sample spikes. Detection: treat a value as a spike if it exceeds rolling median * 3 and is > median + 4*MAD. Render raw line faint, smoothed overlay for trend. Isolated spikes get a callout badge; sustained ones switch to full scale.

Marta (Frontend): Implementation plan: chart.config.compactAxis = true|false. Compact shows 2-3 ticks, a unit header, and an inline "+n spikes" badge. Badge opens a mini-list with timestamps and delta %. Prototype will use lightweight Canvas for lines + DOM for badges for accessibility.

Luis (A11y): Accessibility notes: label the badge control "Show spike details". Keyboard focus must expose a table of spike rows (time, value, % change). Screen readers should announce any automatic suppression: "Chart y-axis stabilized; 2 spikes summarized." Ensure color contrast on badges and halo meets AA.

Rae (Design): Visuals: spike markers small (5px circle), halo subtle 12% opacity, dotted smoothed overlay. When in compact mode, append unit to panel header instead of per-tick. Add micro-tooltip on hover: "Spike at <time>: +245% vs median".

Kai (Data Viz): Edgecases: if a spike lasts 2+ samples treat as short-lived trend and label accordingly but do not suppress. Provide user toggle to disable smoothing on panel. Also propose an internal test harness with three canonical datasets: clean, noisy, spike-only.

Marta (Frontend): Pseudo:
```
const isSpike = (v, median, mad) => v > Math.max(median*3, median + 4*mad);
if (isSpike(v)) addSpikeRecord(t, v);
else updateTrend(v);
```
I'll push PR with canvas prototype and a11y hooks.

Ben (PM): Rollout plan: feature flag chart.compactification initially for mobile-only beta orgs. Metric: expansion rate (how often users click "Show spike details").

flag-bot: Feature flag "chart.compactification" created in staging.

Luis (A11y): Add NVDA/VO test cases for the badge and expanded table. Also automated lint for color contrast on badge text.

Rae (Design): Actions: Marta prototype, Kai will supply datasets, Luis a11y criteria, Ben rollout plan. Meet in 48h for review. :thumbsup:
